event_dangdang_greedy_merchant_r0.scene: SETTING: the same wooden crate stall covered with a cream cloth with a red patterned border, on a patch of grey stone floor, as in reference image 3. The fat GREY cat merchant in a dark brown robe, with small round gold wire glasses, stands behind the stall on the right. He has just handed over the goods and now holds up a brass TELESCOPE in both paws, pushing it toward Dangdang with a greedy, pleading grin and a small sweat drop - trying to sell it for twenty more. The telescope's front glass lens has a clear white CRACK line across it. Dangdang stands on the left facing the merchant. In his LEFT paw he firmly holds the small round blue potion bottle he just bought. His RIGHT paw is raised in front of his chest with the open palm turned toward the telescope in a clear 'no thanks' gesture (whole open paw, all fingers together - no single raised finger). He shakes his head: eyes half closed, mouth a flat unimpressed line, two short motion lines beside his head. Dangdang's paws do NOT touch the telescope. On the cloth only a gold paw-print coin and a small red drawstring pouch remain.

event_dangdang_moving_rat_r0.scene: SETTING: copy reference image 3: the same grey stone steps with grass tufts, the scattered gold coins, the string of wooden beads, the rolled scroll and the small brown pouch on the steps, and the same big brown rat with pink ears sitting on the steps with its huge patched sack tied on its back. The rat keeps its eyes closed and holds, in one paw close to its sack, the item it just took from Dangdang: a small worn bronze amulet on a frayed cord. The trade is done. Dangdang stands upright and still on the right, facing the rat. He holds the two new items the rat gave him against his chest (a gold coin in one paw, a short string of wooden beads in the other), both firmly held. But his eyes are NOT on the new items: his gaze lingers on the worn bronze amulet in the rat's paw. Quiet, faintly reluctant, wistful face: mouth CLOSED in a small flat line, eyebrows slightly tilted up, soft half-lidded eyes, ears drooping a little. He is NOT smiling and NOT excited: no open mouth, no teeth, no sparkle or excitement marks.

event_dangdang_pigeon_lost_r1.scene: SETTING: the same dungeon corner as in reference image 3: a patch of stone floor, a continuous stone-block wall rising from the floor with a lit wall torch on its left part, and a small barred iron window set high up INSIDE the wall on the right. Dangdang stands on the floor below the window, a small brown tool bag with an open flap on his belt. In his RIGHT paw he firmly grips a pair of dark iron PLIERS (wire cutters), lowered to his side - he has just cut the strap. A cut piece of brown strap dangles from one of the window bars, its cut end hanging loose. The fat grey postman PIGEON has popped free: it flies in the open air OUTSIDE the window, up and to the right, wings spread, wearing only its navy postman cap - NO strap and NO satchel anywhere on its body. The empty brown postman satchel lies on the floor. Many envelopes lie scattered flat all over the floor around Dangdang's feet, and a small tied cloth gift pouch (the pigeon's thank-you gift) lies on the floor by his foot. Dangdang looks DOWN at the scattered letters with a puzzled, slightly troubled face and a small sweat drop, mouth closed.
